factions.name: The Harbor Watch
factions.blurb: Captain Vey remembers your help at the burning docks. The Watch is willing to overlook a few irregularities, but your faces are now familiar at every gate.

factions.name: The Gilded Ledger
factions.blurb: Your interference with the salt shipment cost the guild a small fortune. Its factors are asking pointed questions about your next destination. A repayment or a useful favor might settle the account.

factions.name: The Lantern Keepers
factions.blurb: The recovered shrine bell has earned you a warm welcome. Sister Ilya offers shelter, healing, and a place to speak freely. The order considers you trusted friends.

factions.name: The Ash Court
factions.blurb: Rumors of your exploits have reached the court, but nobody has put names to them yet. The upcoming masquerade could be your first opportunity to make an impression.

factions.name: The Black Sails
factions.blurb: After the warehouse raid, the network knows exactly who you are. Trusted dockworkers say your descriptions are circulating among its crews. Traveling alone near the waterfront would be unwise.

factions.name: The Mossbound Circle
factions.blurb: A ranger carried word of your kindness to the marsh villages. Most of the Circle has never heard of you, but that first story was a favorable one.
